remarks: A new home in the Via Bluffs, designed to make everyday life feel simple. Just a few blocks from the newly reopened Palisades Village, 683 N Hampden Place is currently under construction by Rolen Construction, with completion currently anticipated for fall of 2027. The two-story design is planned to offer three bedrooms and three bathrooms, including a separately accessed JADU with its own bedroom and bathroom, currently in the permitting process. It creates flexible additional space for guests, working from home or simply having somewhere separate when you need it. Inside, light does much of the work.
